title: Does discovery-based instruction enhance learning?
verified_evidence: Crossref works/10.1037/a0021017 returned title, four authors, J. Educ. Psychol. 103(1) 1-18, 2011; full text PDF also read (fisme.science.uu.nl copy) confirming abstract and effect sizes.

title: Why minimal guidance during instruction does not work: an analysis of the failure of constructivist, discovery, problem-based, experiential, and inquiry-based teaching
verified_evidence: Crossref works/10.1207/s15326985ep4102_1 returned the title, authors, Educational Psychologist 41(2) 75-86, June 2006; the 2007 reply (DOI 10.1080/00461520701263426) was read in full text and web search summarized the abstract.

title: Focus on formative feedback
verified_evidence: Crossref works/10.3102/0034654307313795 returned title, author, Rev. Educ. Res. 78(1) 153-189, March 2008; full text PDF read (myweb.fsu.edu/vshute).

title: Development and use of the ARCS model of instructional design
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
verified_evidence: Crossref query for the title returned DOI 10.1007/bf02905780, J. Instr. Dev. 10(3) 2-10, Sept 1987; full text PDF read (ocw.tudelft.nl copy).

title: The role of tutoring in problem solving
container_title: Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry
verified_evidence: Crossref returned DOI 10.1111/j.1469-7610.1976.tb00381.x, title, three authors, JCPP 17(2) 89-100, April 1976; full text read as PDF (copy at sachafund.wordpress.com).

title: Should there be a three-strikes rule against pure discovery learning? The case for guided methods of instruction
verified_evidence: Crossref returned DOI 10.1037/0003-066x.59.1.14, Am. Psychol. 59(1) 14-19, 2004; full text read as PDF (csun.edu copy).

title: First principles of instruction
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
verified_evidence: Crossref returned DOI 10.1007/bf02505024, ETR&D 50(3) 43-59, Sept 2002; Springer page abstract read (five principles). Companion Pebble-in-the-Pond article (Performance Improvement 41(7)) read in full from itgs.ict.usc.edu.

title: The 2 sigma problem: the search for methods of group instruction as effective as one-to-one tutoring
verified_evidence: Crossref returned DOI 10.3102/0013189x013006004, Educ. Researcher 13(6) 4-16, June 1984; full text read as PDF (gwern.net copy); critical account by von Hippel (Education Next, 2024) read as PDF.

title: Effectiveness of mastery learning programs: a meta-analysis
verified_evidence: Crossref returned DOI 10.3102/00346543060002265, Rev. Educ. Res. 60(2) 265-299, 1990; full text read as PDF (typeset.io copy).

title: Visible learning: a synthesis of over 800 meta-analyses relating to achievement
verified_evidence: Crossref works query returned DOI 10.4324/9780203887332 (Visible Learning, Hattie, Routledge, online 2008); Routledge product page (ISBN 9780415476188 in URL) gave the title, copyright 2009, 392 pages and description of over 800 meta-analyses. Critique read: Bergeron and Rivard 2017, McGill J. Educ. 52(1), DOI 10.7202/1040816ar.

title: Principles of instruction: research-based strategies that all teachers should know
verified_evidence: Web search returned the AFT-hosted PDF; the PDF was downloaded and read in full (title, author, American Educator Spring 2012 pp. 12-19, ten principles). Not found in Crossref.

title: Reconsidering research on learning from media
verified_evidence: Crossref returned DOI 10.3102/00346543053004445, Rev. Educ. Res. 53(4) 445-459, Dec 1983; full text read as PDF (typeset.io copy).

title: Ten steps to complex learning: a new approach to instruction and instructional design
verified_evidence: Crossref returned DOI 10.4135/9781412964012.n26 (SAGE 2008, authors Kirschner and van Merrienboer); full text of the chapter read as PDF from research.ou.nl, whose citation line gives editor T. L. Good, Vol. 1, pp. 244-253.

title: Understanding by design
publisher: Association for Supervision and Curriculum Development
verified_evidence: Open Library search returned work OL1908804W (Understanding by Design, Wiggins and McTighe, ASCD, isbn 9781416600350); ASCD product page confirmed authors, ISBN 978-1-4166-0035-0, 370 pages; full text scan of the expanded 2nd edition read (copyright page: 2005, ASCD).

title: A revision of Bloom's taxonomy: an overview
verified_evidence: Crossref returned DOI 10.1207/s15430421tip4104_2, Theory Into Practice 41(4) 212-218, Nov 2002; full text read as PDF (ocw.metu.edu.tr copy); ERIC EJ667155 abstract seen in search results.

title: The effects of behavioral objectives on learning: a review of empirical studies
publisher: Florida State University, Computer-Assisted Instruction Center
verified_evidence: ERIC ED066909 full text downloaded and read (abstract, groups of studies, rationales). Crossref lists the revised journal version as DOI 10.2307/1170121, Rev. Educ. Res. 43, 53 (1973); the DOI is not used here because the text read was the 1972 tech memo.

title: The conditions of learning and theory of instruction
verified_evidence: Open Library works/OL11281691W editions: 'The conditions of learning and theory of instruction', 4th ed., 1985, Holt, Rinehart and Winston, New York and London, isbn 0030636884, 361 pages. Content from two open secondary summaries (LibreTexts, Simply Psychology); book not read.
